subject: Introduction - new AR contact
text:
Hi Renee,

I've taken over from Patty, who retired at the end of October. Looking forward to working with you. I'll be your go-to for statements and disputes.

With the finance system migration Patty started, our deposit information is different now, so I'll get you the replacement ACH form this week. Please start using it as soon as you have it.

Best,
Brandon Ellis
Accounts Receivable, Cobalt Freight LLC
